expectedIssues: Profile is highlighted in the bottom nav bar while the home feed is shown
reportedIssues: The bottom navigation shows 'Profile' as the active tab (green icon and label) even though the visible content is the Home/discovery feed with address, search and restaurant lists.

The favorite heart button on the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card is a white outline heart inside a white circle over a light area of the photo, making it nearly invisible, while the pizza card below uses a dark circle with a white heart. The two are visually inconsistent.

The third card in the 'Fastest near you' carousel shows 'Trattoria Piccol' cut off mid-word at the screen edge with no ellipsis, so the name reads as broken text rather than a deliberately peeked card.

Card imagery is inconsistent: the 'Green Bowl Poké' thumbnail sits on a very light grey background while the neighbouring burger and pasta thumbnails use dark photographic backgrounds, so the row looks uneven and the first card appears unloaded.

The second 'Popular right now' card (pizza, −20% badge) is abruptly clipped by the fixed bottom navigation bar with no fade or spacing, so its title and metadata are hidden and the layout looks cut off.
Tokumaru Ramen Bar shows '€0 delivery' twice — once as an image badge and again in the metadata line under the title — which reads as duplicated information.
The category chip row is cut mid-chip at the right edge with only a sliver of the next chip visible, which can look like a rendering glitch rather than a scrollable row.
The decorative circles in the green promo banner are clipped asymmetrically at the right/bottom edges, creating an unbalanced overlap behind the 'Order now' button area.
